promotion_status: NOT_PROMOTED — LAB_EXPERIMENT only, requires n>=100 evidence gate + operator sign-off
invalidated_reason: course_return_flag correlated with an 87.9% win rate in training (vs 13.0% base rate) because build_rpdc_daily.py._fetch_horse_history() had no run_date cutoff excluding the current race day. Any RPDC row regenerated/backfilled after that day results were ingested into racing_horse_runs leaked the horse's own outcome into its own "history". Confirmed by checking the genuinely clean (same-day-generated) subset: course_return_flag win rate drops to 16.7% (n=6), consistent with the 13.0% base rate. Root cause fixed 2026-07-27 in build_rpdc_daily.py (_fetch_horse_history and _trainer_stats both now enforce run_date < today). This model must not be used, cited, or promoted -- its AUC/top-1 numbers are leakage artifacts, not real predictive signal.
